_comment: The Agentic Top Ten — the canonical demo/test reel of end-to-end agentic journeys a CLI agent (Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity) can drive over the tunnel by name. RULE #1: this is CONTENT. The binary knows how to RUN a named agent (NamedAgentResolver) and nothing about which journeys exist — adding one is a PR, no rebuild. Each journey ends in a durable EndProduct openable from the Workbench Products surface. `runs.via` ∈ {pipeline, wizard, relevanceScan, aiwebHeadless, applet}. `status`: works | gap (gap = capability partial, tracked in docs/AGENTIC_TOP_TEN.md). Drive one with runNamedAgent {name|id, input?}; discover all with listNamedAgents.

journeys.name: AI Papers Relevance
journeys.says: Run my AI Web 'AI papers score for relevance' and report on the latest AI papers.
journeys.blurb: Scores every paper on an arxiv listing against your stated interests and reports the top hits.

runs.context: papers relevant to agentic AI, LLM tool use, on-device inference, and coding agents

journeys.name: Absurd News
journeys.says: Run my Absurd News ToonStudio Agent.
journeys.blurb: Picks three genuinely ironic news stories and films a 60-second two-anchor satirical bulletin.

journeys.name: Seattle Center Dinner Pick
journeys.says: I'm looking for a restaurant tonight around 6pm at the Seattle Center — what should I consider?
journeys.blurb: Reasons over nearby restaurants for a 6pm table and saves an openable recommendation.

args.query: dinner tonight around 6pm near the Seattle Center, ideally walkable and able to seat two on short notice

journeys.name: Seattle & Tech News Podcast
journeys.says: Give me a summary of Seattle and Tech news and turn it into a podcast.
journeys.blurb: Pulls the day's Seattle-local and technology-industry news, writes a spoken briefing, and voices it as an audio episode.

runs.input: Seattle local news and the technology industry, today

journeys.name: Seattle Eats Website
journeys.says: Build me a Seattle best-places-to-eat website, based on my Seattle restaurants ledger.
journeys.blurb: Generates a browsable, filterable 'best places to eat in Seattle' website from your Seattle restaurants list.

runs.goal: Build a 'Best Places to Eat in Seattle' website: a clean, filterable single-page web app that lists Seattle restaurants grouped by neighborhood, each with a short note, cuisine tag, and a link. Source it from my Seattle restaurants list.

journeys.name: Classic Story Cartoon
journeys.says: Turn 'Jack and the Beanstalk' into a cartoon.
journeys.blurb: Same named-agent machinery as Absurd News, different recipe — proves the mechanism is general.

journeys.name: mChatAI+ Hero Shot
journeys.says: Generate a product photo for mChatAI+.
journeys.blurb: A single-shot image generation that lands a real endproduct-image in the vault.

runs.input: a sleek product hero shot for mChatAI+, a Mac app that turns your coding agent into a control plane for your apps — a MacBook on a clean light-wood desk showing a colorful grid of app tiles, soft daylight, crisp modern product photography, shallow depth of field

journeys.name: Pitch Deck from Notes
journeys.says: Compose a short pitch deck about mChatAI+.
journeys.blurb: Composes a themed slide deck from a prompt.

runs.input: a 6-slide pitch deck for mChatAI+: the problem (standalone AI-agent surfaces don't stick), the solution (drive your own apps by name from your coding agent), how it works, what makes it different (runs on your machine, every result is a durable artifact you own), traction, and the ask

journeys.name: Web Research Brief
journeys.says: Write me a grounded research brief on current agentic trends in AI.
journeys.blurb: A cited, grounded research brief pipeline that ends in a saved report.

journeys.name: Podcast from Text
journeys.says: Turn this text into a two-host podcast episode.
journeys.blurb: Text in, multi-voice audio episode out — a second audio journey distinct from the news briefing.

runs.input: Agentic platforms are moving from chat destinations to background workers. The interesting shift is that the coding agent — Claude Code, Codex — becomes the control plane, and the app becomes a set of named, runnable capabilities that leave durable products behind.
